entitlements.verify: Play Developer API authoritative purchase state; validate package, product, purchase token, quantity and state; installation identifier is never ownership proof
entitlements.record_key: SHA256(purchase_token); token encrypted/protected server-side only where needed for reverification
entitlements.client_grant: Persist server-signed verified entitlement and grant journal atomically; recover safely after interrupted local persistence. Backend durable entitlement is restorable; no pending purchase benefit.
entitlements.pending: no benefit until authoritative PURCHASED/verified; process redelivery safely
entitlements.offline: retain last verified ownership on connectivity failures; only authoritative revocation removes entitlement
entitlements.restore: query actual Play ownership, verify tokens, rebuild local entitlements; does not restore local campaign
entitlements.refunds: RTDN ingestion idempotent + reverification on online restore/ownership refresh; periodic server-side voided-purchases reconciliation
entitlements.rtdn: authenticated Google Pub/Sub trigger; event is a hint, fetch authoritative state; never trust unverified client refund input
entitlements.acknowledgement: Backend orchestrator is canonical acknowledgement owner after durable VERIFIED_GRANTED record; retries are idempotent. Unity IAP confirms local order only after durable verified entitlement; prove no second consumptive grant/ack path. Never consume non-consumables.
entitlements.offline_receipt: Server-signed ES256 JWS with product, token hash, issued_at and key ID; verify with bundled public keys; keep last valid ownership offline. Signing key is server-only. Never treat local checksum as purchase proof.
entitlements.signature_key_rotation: Ship new public key before using it; support previous keys for existing clients. No expiry-based removal on temporary offline use.

saves.write: temp + flush + verify + atomic replacement; preserve backup
saves.unknown_newer_schema: refuse destructive migration; retain files and explain
saves.reset: two-step confirmation; reset gameplay only; keep entitlements, privacy choice and accessibility settings
saves.android_backup: explicitly exclude game save and entitlement cache from cloud backup/device-transfer rules; local-only promise; no OS-backup dependency

ads.show_attempt_receipt: journal attempt ID before show; persist earned reward immediately; deduplicate; stale reroll receipt applies only to its owning active run; if run has ended, consume with logged inapplicable reason, no new free run
ads.no_fill: normal play plus manual retry; no repeated auto-popups
ads.preload: only if consent permits and an eligible non-intro placement can be reached
ads.price_text: localized Play price only; unavailable price disables purchase CTA but not play

privacy.crash_collection: deliberate consent/lawful-basis configuration per actual region; not assumed covered by UMP
privacy.data_minimization: No precise location, email, birthday, address, free text, raw order IDs or tokens in gameplay events
privacy.financial_retention: actual applicable accounting/legal schedule at deployment; cannot invent required period
privacy.analytics_choice: Separate in-app optional diagnostics choice (off by default), independent of UMP advertising choice; no ad denial penalty, no pre-consent backfill.

remote_config.activate: Home or next expedition; never mid-run

spending.existing_provider_credits: Use only in separately authorized asset task; access is not unlimited-spend permission

support_identity: Production input held until owner-supplied verified entity/domain/email; show noncommercial local diagnostic copy in development without fake contact addresses.
integration_stage: PH05; no SDK/backend installation or live account activity in CORE-001 beyond stub interfaces
offline_revocation_limitation: A device that never reconnects cannot learn a refund/revocation. Offline preservation is deliberate; do not claim perfect anti-fraud.
